title: Documentation of Heyo [auk], a Torricelli language of Papua New Guinea
text: Heyo is a Torricelli language spoken in the area between the Torricelli Mountains and the Sepik Plain. It is spoken by approximately 1,000 - 1,500 people. This collection is part of a larger project involving the documentation and linguistic description of Heyo. The data will contain traditional narratives, folk histories, naturalistic conversation, and cultural performances.
